edge_scale.reason: Duplicate discount-rate channel. Mechanism text: funding cost -1% PAT plus 'multiple compression (long-duration annuity) -2.0'. The F_GSEC_10Y_IN edge (-2.5) already carries cap-rate and 'growth-multiple effect on a 57x P/E', and its own text says 'Overlaps with repo (parallel path flagged)'. Repo -> G-sec (0.53) adds a further path. Keep only the funding part (~-1.0). One 25bp hike plus 39bp G-sec currently books -7.0% raw for a mall owner whose Q2 consumption grew 25% and stock rose +14.8% market-adjusted since June.

Unit slip. Mechanism scales +Rs70cr/yr interest by PAT (Rs788cr TTM, P/E 178) to get -9% PAT and then -3% equity. Equity value is a DCF of regulated airports (mcap ~Rs1.05 lakh cr at Rs99.4): Rs70cr/yr pre-tax for ~2 years is ~0.1-0.2% of value, and AERA's regulatory-asset-base model trues up the actual cost of debt in aero tariffs. The discount-rate effect is in the F_GSEC_10Y_IN edge (-2.5), which also gets repo via the 0.53 backbone path. -3.0 -> ~-1.0.

Same PAT-scaling slip: +50bp on ~Rs25k cr refinanced = Rs125cr/yr, which is called '-16% PAT' and becomes -3.5% equity. On a ~Rs1.05 lakh cr equity value that is ~0.3-0.5% for a multi-year effect, part of it passed through via AERA true-ups. -3.5 -> -1.4 (still above the arithmetic, to allow for refinancing risk).

Duplicate channel. The direct edge includes 'buyers' EMI +2% -> volumes -1.2% -> -1.0%'. That is the same economics as backbone F_REPO_IN -> F_HOUSING_DEMAND (-0.26) -> LODHA (+6.0), which still adds ~-0.8 after OVERLAP_DAMP. Remove the EMI piece: -3.5 -> ~-2.45. The agent's own evidence says Lodha rose 4% on 2026-09-18 on rate-hike bets.

Half of the -2.5 is a 'discount-rate effect on P/E 17.9: -1.3%'. That duplicates the F_GSEC_10Y_IN edge (-1.5, 'cost of equity') and the repo -> G-sec backbone path. findings.subject: Unpriced-recent-impact rule (universe; drives 9 of my 13 names)
findings.issue: Across all 198 names with prices, the model's beta-adjusted Jun-Nov impact is NEGATIVELY correlated with the realised market-adjusted move: Pearson -0.33, Spearman -0.34, OLS slope -0.93. By model quintile, mean realised is -0.2 / +5.6 / -3.5 / -7.9 / -13.6 from the most negative to the most positive model quintile. In 121 of 200 names the realised sign contradicts the model. The bounding rule then books the FULL model impact as 'unpriced' exactly when the stock moved the other way, so the 12m score systematically penalises recent outperformers that the model expected to underperform. That is a de-facto reversal bet, contrary to the 'no mean-reversion bet' design. Unpriced corr with exp_rel_return_12m = 0.86. For my names, 0.5 x unpriced is -4.6 of -6.1 (FEDERALBNK), -3.6/-6.5 (TORNTPHARM), -3.6/-5.8 (ZYDUSLIFE), -3.1/-5.7 (PHOENIXLTD), -2.1/-3.4 (LODHA). EXACT FIX (Director): when sign(realised) != sign(model) and |realised| > |model|, set unpriced = 0 (or cut the recent weight 0.5 -> 0.15 until the recent-state model shows positive cross-sectional skill). Under the first option my names move to: FEDERALBNK 183->135, LODHA 159->128, ZYDUSLIFE 179->152, PHOENIXLTD 177->157, TORNTPHARM 189->160. SHRIRAMFIN/GMRAIRPORT stay at the bottom (realised agrees in sign).
